options.content:
- Use Cases: This dashboard shows the basic Git and Code Review metrics from GitLab.
- Data Source Required: GitLab

panels.description:
MRs created in the selected period. Filtered by MR author; MRs imported from GitHub are left out and drafts are included.
datasource: pull_requests, pull_request_comments, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- MRs created in the range.
-- Filtered by MR author (the developer variable lists GitLab usernames; All applies no filter), bots left out. MRs
-- imported from GitHub (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboards A, C and I) are left out; drafts are
-- included, as on GitHub J.
SELECT COUNT(*) AS merge_request_count
FROM pull_requests pr
WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
  AND ('__all__' IN (${developer}) OR pr.author_name IN (${developer}))
  AND pr.author_name NOT LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%'
  AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})));

panels.title: 3.1 Number of New Merge Requests

panels.description:
MRs created per month or week. Filtered by MR author; MRs imported from GitHub are left out and drafts are included.
datasource: pull_requests, pull_request_comments, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- MRs created per month or week.
-- Filtered by MR author (the developer variable lists GitLab usernames; All applies no filter), bots left out. MRs
-- imported from GitHub (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboards A, C and I) are left out; drafts are
-- included, as on GitHub J.
WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN '$interval' = 'WEEKDAY' THEN DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.created_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.created_date) DAY) ELSE DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.created_date), INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(pr.created_date) - 1 DAY) END AS time,
         COUNT(*) AS mr_count
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
    AND ('__all__' IN (${developer}) OR pr.author_name IN (${developer}))
    AND pr.author_name NOT LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%'
    AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  GROUP BY time
)
SELECT CASE WHEN '$interval' = 'DAYOFMONTH' THEN DATE_FORMAT(time, '%M %Y') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(time, 'W%v %x') END AS _time,
       mr_count AS "Merge Request Count"
FROM buckets
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: 3.2 Number of New Merge Requests

panels.description:
Top 20 authors by merged MRs created in the period. Filtered by MR author; MRs imported from GitHub are left out and drafts are included.
datasource: pull_requests, pull_request_comments, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Top 20 authors by MRs created in the range that are merged.
-- Filtered by MR author (the developer variable lists GitLab usernames; All applies no filter), bots left out. MRs
-- imported from GitHub (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboards A, C and I) are left out; drafts are
-- included, as on GitHub J.
SELECT REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(MAX(a.full_name), _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(MIN(u.name)), '') FROM user_accounts ua JOIN users u ON u.id = ua.user_id WHERE ua.account_id = pr.author_id), MAX(pr.author_name)), '-', ' ') AS contributor,
       COUNT(*) AS merged_merge_request_count
FROM pull_requests pr
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
  AND pr.status = 'MERGED'
  AND ('__all__' IN (${developer}) OR pr.author_name IN (${developer}))
  AND pr.author_name NOT LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%'
  AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
GROUP BY pr.author_id
ORDER BY merged_merge_request_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: 3.3 Top 20 Contributors By Merged MRs

panels.description:
Per reviewer, the latest decision on each MR reviewed in the period: approved, rejected (GitLab unapproval) or commented, on other people's MRs (top 20). Filtered by reviewer.
datasource: pull_request_comments, pull_requests, accounts, users, user_accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Per reviewer, on other people's MRs, the latest decision on each MR in the range: approved, rejected (a GitLab
-- unapproval, stored as a NORMAL comment with status CHANGES_REQUESTED) or, with no decision, commented. Top 20.
-- Filtered by the reviewer's username (All applies no filter). Bot reviewers, imported GitHub notes and AI-tool notes are
-- left out, as on dashboard B.
WITH reviews AS (
  SELECT c.account_id,
         c.pull_request_id,
         -- the reviewer's latest approval or unapproval on the MR, else 'COMMENTED'
         COALESCE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN (c.type = 'REVIEW' AND c.status = 'APPROVED') OR c.status = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED'
                                                    THEN c.status END ORDER BY c.created_date DESC), ',', 1), 'COMMENTED') AS decision
  FROM pull_request_comments c
  JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = c.pull_request_id
  JOIN accounts ra      ON ra.id = c.account_id
  WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND ('__all__' IN (${developer}) OR ra.user_name IN (${developer}))
    AND ra.user_name NOT LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%'
    AND c.account_id <> pr.author_id
    AND NOT (c.body LIKE '*Created by%' OR c.body LIKE '*Merged by%') AND NOT (c.body LIKE 'Preparing PR description%' OR c.body LIKE 'Preparing review%' OR c.body LIKE '## PR Reviewer Guide%' OR c.body LIKE '## PR Code Suggestions%' OR c.body LIKE '**[Persistent review]%' OR c.body LIKE '**[PR Description]%')
    AND $__timeFilter(c.created_date)
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  GROUP BY c.account_id, c.pull_request_id
)
SELECT REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(a.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(MIN(u.name)), '') FROM user_accounts ua JOIN users u ON u.id = ua.user_id WHERE ua.account_id = a.id), a.user_name), '-', ' ') AS reviewer,
       SUM(r.decision = 'APPROVED')          AS approved,
       SUM(r.decision = 'CHANGES_REQUESTED') AS rejected,
       SUM(r.decision = 'COMMENTED')         AS commented
FROM reviews r
JOIN accounts a ON a.id = r.account_id
GROUP BY a.id, a.full_name, a.user_name
ORDER BY (approved + rejected + commented) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: 3.4 Top 20 MR Contributions by Review

targets.rawSql:
-- The repo's commits in the range, merge commits excluded, as on dashboard B. Commit authors are matched to GitLab
-- accounts as on dashboard B and filtered by that account's username (All applies no filter), bots left out;
-- commits that match no GitLab account are left out.
WITH scoped_commits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.sha, c.author_email, c.author_name, c.additions, c.deletions
  FROM commits c
  JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha
  WHERE rc.repo_id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id = rc.repo_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
    AND $__timeFilter(c.authored_date)
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commit_parents cp WHERE cp.commit_sha = c.sha) < 2
),
gitlab_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.id, LOWER(a.user_name) AS login, LOWER(TRIM(a.full_name)) AS name
  FROM accounts a
  WHERE a.id LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%' AND a.id NOT LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0'
),
commit_authors AS (
  -- GitLab accounts carry no email, so a commit author is matched to a GitLab account by the email's local part
  -- against the username, then by the author name against the username, then by a unique full name.
  SELECT e.author_email,
         e.author_name,
         COALESCE(
           MIN(by_email.id),
           MIN(by_login.id),
           CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT by_name.id) = 1 THEN MIN(by_name.id) END
         ) AS account_id
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT author_email, author_name FROM scoped_commits) e
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_email ON by_email.login = LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(e.author_email, '@', 1))
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_login ON by_login.login = LOWER(TRIM(e.author_name))
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_name  ON by_name.name   = LOWER(TRIM(e.author_name))
  GROUP BY e.author_email, e.author_name
)
SELECT REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(ga.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(MIN(u.name)), '') FROM user_accounts ua JOIN users u ON u.id = ua.user_id WHERE ua.account_id = ga.id), ga.user_name), '-', ' ') AS contributor,
       SUM(sc.additions) AS `Lines Added`,
       SUM(sc.deletions) AS `Lines Removed`
FROM scoped_commits sc
JOIN commit_authors ca ON ca.author_email <=> sc.author_email AND ca.author_name <=> sc.author_name
JOIN accounts ga       ON ga.id = ca.account_id
WHERE ('__all__' IN (${developer}) OR ga.user_name IN (${developer}))
  AND ga.user_name NOT LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%'
GROUP BY ga.id, ga.full_name, ga.user_name
ORDER BY SUM(sc.additions) + SUM(sc.deletions) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: 3.5 Top 20 Code Changes by Developer
panels.description:
Lines added and removed per developer (top 20), merge commits excluded. Commit authors are matched to GitLab accounts by email or name and filtered by developer; unmatched commits are left out.
datasource: commits, repo_commits, commit_parents, accounts, users, user_accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- The repo's commits in the range, merge commits excluded, as on dashboard B. Commit authors are matched to GitLab
-- accounts as on dashboard B and filtered by that account's username (All applies no filter), bots left out;
-- commits that match no GitLab account are left out.
WITH scoped_commits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.sha, c.author_email, c.author_name, c.additions, c.deletions

    AND rc.repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm

                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
    AND $__timeFilter(c.authored_date)
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commit_parents cp WHERE cp.commit_sha = c.sha) < 2
),
gitlab_accounts AS (
  SELECT a.id, LOWER(a.user_name) AS login, LOWER(TRIM(a.full_name)) AS name
  FROM accounts a
  WHERE a.id LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%' AND a.id NOT LIKE 'gitlab:GitlabAccount:%:0'
),
commit_authors AS (
  -- GitLab accounts carry no email, so a commit author is matched to a GitLab account by the email's local part
  -- against the username, then by the author name against the username, then by a unique full name.
  SELECT e.author_email,
         e.author_name,
         COALESCE(
           MIN(by_email.id),
           MIN(by_login.id),
           CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT by_name.id) = 1 THEN MIN(by_name.id) END
         ) AS account_id
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT author_email, author_name FROM scoped_commits) e
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_email ON by_email.login = LOWER(SUBSTRING_INDEX(e.author_email, '@', 1))
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_login ON by_login.login = LOWER(TRIM(e.author_name))
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_accounts by_name  ON by_name.name   = LOWER(TRIM(e.author_name))
  GROUP BY e.author_email, e.author_name
)
SELECT REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(REPLACE(ga.full_name, _utf8mb4 X'E2808B', '')), ''), (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(MIN(u.name)), '') FROM user_accounts ua JOIN users u ON u.id = ua.user_id WHERE ua.account_id = ga.id), ga.user_name), '-', ' ') AS contributor,
       COUNT(*) AS commit_count
FROM scoped_commits sc
JOIN commit_authors ca ON ca.author_email <=> sc.author_email AND ca.author_name <=> sc.author_name
JOIN accounts ga       ON ga.id = ca.account_id
WHERE ('__all__' IN (${developer}) OR ga.user_name IN (${developer}))
  AND ga.user_name NOT LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%'
GROUP BY ga.id, ga.full_name, ga.user_name
ORDER BY commit_count DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: 3.6 Top 20 Contributors by Commits
panels.description:
Commits per developer (top 20), merge commits excluded. Commit authors are matched to GitLab accounts by email or name and filtered by developer; unmatched commits are left out.
datasource: commits, repo_commits, commit_parents, accounts, users, user_accounts, project_mapping

% of closed MRs that were closed without merging. Filtered by MR author; MRs imported from GitHub are left out and drafts are included.
datasource: pull_requests, pull_request_comments, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Share of closed MRs (merged or not) created in the range that were closed without merging.
-- Filtered by MR author (the developer variable lists GitLab usernames; All applies no filter), bots left out. MRs
-- imported from GitHub (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboards A, C and I) are left out; drafts are
-- included, as on GitHub J.
SELECT SUM(pr.status = 'CLOSED') / NULLIF(SUM(pr.status IN ('CLOSED', 'MERGED')), 0) AS ratio
FROM pull_requests pr
WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
  AND ('__all__' IN (${developer}) OR pr.author_name IN (${developer}))
  AND pr.author_name NOT LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%'
  AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})));

panels.title: 4.1 Ratio of unmerged MRs of All Closed MRs

panels.description:
Open, closed and merged MRs per creation month or week. Filtered by MR author; MRs imported from GitHub are left out and drafts are included.
datasource: pull_requests, pull_request_comments, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- MRs created per month or week by current status.
-- Filtered by MR author (the developer variable lists GitLab usernames; All applies no filter), bots left out. MRs
-- imported from GitHub (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboards A, C and I) are left out; drafts are
-- included, as on GitHub J.
WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN '$interval' = 'WEEKDAY' THEN DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.created_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.created_date) DAY) ELSE DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.created_date), INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(pr.created_date) - 1 DAY) END AS time,
         SUM(pr.status = 'OPEN')   AS open,
         SUM(pr.status = 'CLOSED') AS closed,
         SUM(pr.status = 'MERGED') AS merged
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
    AND ('__all__' IN (${developer}) OR pr.author_name IN (${developer}))
    AND pr.author_name NOT LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%'
    AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  GROUP BY time
)
SELECT CASE WHEN '$interval' = 'DAYOFMONTH' THEN DATE_FORMAT(time, '%M %Y') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(time, 'W%v %x') END AS _time,
       open   AS "MR: Open",
       closed AS "MR: Closed without merging",
       merged AS "MR: Closed and merged"
FROM buckets
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: 4.2 Merge Request Status Distribution

panels.description:
MRs created in the period that were closed without merging. Filtered by MR author; MRs imported from GitHub are left out and drafts are included.
datasource: pull_requests, pull_request_comments, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- MRs created in the range that were closed without merging.
-- Filtered by MR author (the developer variable lists GitLab usernames; All applies no filter), bots left out. MRs
-- imported from GitHub (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboards A, C and I) are left out; drafts are
-- included, as on GitHub J.

  AND pr.author_name NOT LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%'
  AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))

-- imported from GitHub (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboards A, C and I) are left out; drafts are

WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
  AND ('__all__' IN (${developer}) OR pr.author_name IN (${developer}))

  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm

panels.title: 4.4 Ratio of unmerged MRs of All Closed MRs

panels.description:
Average days from creation to merge of MRs created in the period. Filtered by MR author; MRs imported from GitHub are left out and drafts are included.
datasource: pull_requests, pull_request_comments, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Average days from creation to merge of MRs created in the range.
-- Filtered by MR author (the developer variable lists GitLab usernames; All applies no filter), bots left out. MRs
-- imported from GitHub (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboards A, C and I) are left out; drafts are
-- included, as on GitHub J.
SELECT ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, pr.merged_date) / 1440), 1) AS time_to_merge
FROM pull_requests pr
WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
  AND pr.status = 'MERGED'
  AND pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL
  AND ('__all__' IN (${developer}) OR pr.author_name IN (${developer}))
  AND pr.author_name NOT LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%'
  AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})));

panels.title: 4.5 Mean Time to Merge of Merge Requests

panels.description:
Average days from creation to merge, per creation month or week. Filtered by MR author; MRs imported from GitHub are left out and drafts are included.
datasource: pull_requests, pull_request_comments, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Average days from creation to merge of MRs created per month or week.
-- Filtered by MR author (the developer variable lists GitLab usernames; All applies no filter), bots left out. MRs
-- imported from GitHub (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboards A, C and I) are left out; drafts are
-- included, as on GitHub J.
WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN '$interval' = 'WEEKDAY' THEN DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.created_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.created_date) DAY) ELSE DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.created_date), INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(pr.created_date) - 1 DAY) END AS time,
         AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, pr.merged_date) / 1440) AS time_to_merge
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
    AND pr.status = 'MERGED'
    AND pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL
    AND ('__all__' IN (${developer}) OR pr.author_name IN (${developer}))
    AND pr.author_name NOT LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%'
    AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  GROUP BY time
)
SELECT CASE WHEN '$interval' = 'DAYOFMONTH' THEN DATE_FORMAT(time, '%M %Y') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(time, 'W%v %x') END AS _time,
       ROUND(time_to_merge, 1) AS "Time to Merge"
FROM buckets
ORDER BY time;

panels.description:
Average days from creation to close (merged or not) of MRs created in the period; a merged MR closes at its merge date, and a few old MRs (created before 2022) with no close date are left out. Filtered by MR author; MRs imported from GitHub are left out and drafts are included.
datasource: pull_requests, pull_request_comments, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Average days from creation to close (merged or not) of MRs created in the range.
-- GitLab leaves closed_date empty on merged MRs, so a merged MR closes at its merge date. A few old MRs
-- (created before 2022) have no close date at all and are left out.
-- Filtered by MR author (the developer variable lists GitLab usernames; All applies no filter), bots left out. MRs
-- imported from GitHub (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboards A, C and I) are left out; drafts are
-- included, as on GitHub J.
SELECT ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, COALESCE(pr.closed_date, pr.merged_date)) / 1440), 1) AS time_to_close
FROM pull_requests pr
WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
  AND pr.status IN ('CLOSED', 'MERGED')
  AND COALESCE(pr.closed_date, pr.merged_date) IS NOT NULL
  AND ('__all__' IN (${developer}) OR pr.author_name IN (${developer}))
  AND pr.author_name NOT LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%'
  AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
  AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})));

panels.title: 4.7 Mean Time to Close of Merge Requests in Days

panels.description:
Average days from creation to close (merged or not), per creation month or week; a merged MR closes at its merge date. Filtered by MR author; MRs imported from GitHub are left out and drafts are included.
datasource: pull_requests, pull_request_comments, accounts, project_mapping

targets.rawSql:
-- Average days from creation to close (merged or not) of MRs created per month or week.
-- GitLab leaves closed_date empty on merged MRs, so a merged MR closes at its merge date. A few old MRs
-- (created before 2022) have no close date at all and are left out.
-- Filtered by MR author (the developer variable lists GitLab usernames; All applies no filter), bots left out. MRs
-- imported from GitHub (the not_imported_mr constant, shared with dashboards A, C and I) are left out; drafts are
-- included, as on GitHub J.
WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN '$interval' = 'WEEKDAY' THEN DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.created_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.created_date) DAY) ELSE DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.created_date), INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(pr.created_date) - 1 DAY) END AS time,
         AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, COALESCE(pr.closed_date, pr.merged_date)) / 1440) AS time_to_close
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(pr.created_date)
    AND pr.status IN ('CLOSED', 'MERGED')
    AND COALESCE(pr.closed_date, pr.merged_date) IS NOT NULL
    AND ('__all__' IN (${developer}) OR pr.author_name IN (${developer}))
    AND pr.author_name NOT LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%'
    AND ${not_imported_mr:raw}
    AND pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id = pr.base_repo_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
  GROUP BY time
)
SELECT CASE WHEN '$interval' = 'DAYOFMONTH' THEN DATE_FORMAT(time, '%M %Y') ELSE DATE_FORMAT(time, 'W%v %x') END AS _time,
       ROUND(time_to_close, 1) AS "Time to Close"
FROM buckets
ORDER BY time;

targets.rawSql:

-- Pipelines are dated by finished date, or created date for manual pipelines, which never finish.

  AND COALESCE(cp.finished_date, cp.created_date) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN '$interval' = 'WEEKDAY' THEN DATE_SUB(DATE(COALESCE(cp.finished_date, cp.created_date)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(COALESCE(cp.finished_date, cp.created_date)) DAY) ELSE DATE_SUB(DATE(COALESCE(cp.finished_date, cp.created_date)), INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(COALESCE(cp.finished_date, cp.created_date)) - 1 DAY) END AS time,
         SUM(cp.result = 'SUCCESS') AS successful_pipeline_run_count,
         SUM(cp.result = 'FAILURE') AS failed_pipeline_run_count
  FROM cicd_pipelines cp
  WHERE cp.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND COALESCE(cp.finished_date, cp.created_date) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND cp.result IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILURE')
    AND cp.cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))

targets.rawSql:
-- Average duration in minutes of pipelines in the range.
-- Pipelines are dated by finished date, or created date for manual pipelines, which never finish.

SELECT ROUND(AVG(cp.duration_sec / 60), 1) AS duration_in_minutes

  AND COALESCE(cp.finished_date, cp.created_date) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND cp.result IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILURE')
  AND cp.duration_sec > 0
  AND cp.cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))

targets.rawSql:
-- Issues created in the range by status. GitLab leaves original_status empty and issues are only open or closed, so an
-- open issue is In Progress when it has an In Progress, In Review, In QA, Ready to be Merged or Ready For Deployment label,
-- as on dashboards A and E. GitLab board ids are the repo ids.
SELECT CASE WHEN i.status = 'DONE' THEN 'Done' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_labels ilp WHERE ilp.issue_id = i.id AND LOWER(ilp.label_name) IN ('in progress', 'in review', 'in qa', 'ready to be merged (approved)', 'ready for deployment')) THEN 'In Progress' ELSE 'To Do' END AS status,
       COUNT(*) AS issue_count
FROM issues i
JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
JOIN repos r         ON r.id = bi.board_id
WHERE i.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND r.id IN (SELECT pm_g.row_id FROM project_mapping pm_g JOIN user_project_mapping upm_g ON upm_g.project_name = pm_g.project_name WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND pm_g.row_id IN (${repo_id}))
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
               WHERE pm.row_id = r.id
                 AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                 AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN (${project})))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY issue_count DESC;
